about_the_game:
OUTDOOR STARTER PACK DESCRIPTION

The Outdoor Starter Pack adds additional Outdoor Terrain, Minis and Ready-to-Play Maps perfect for when your party decides to travel off the beaten path. The DLC pack for only $9.99 is a $22 value if purchased separately with in-app purchases.

  • Includes the Free Starter Set featuring digital dungeon and cavern terrain, and player minis from Hero Forge, Dwarven Forge, Fat Dragon Games, and Reaper Mini PLUS 8 additional assets perfect for creating outdoor encounters.
  • Forest Terrain tile. Copy these tiles to make the forest as big as your imagination.
  • Forest River tiles make for a water feature to challenge the party
  • Campfire prop around which the party can gather for warmth and to fend off the gathering darkness
  • Tree and Shrub tiles to build a mighty forest to explore
  • Giant Spider mini. Spiders! Why does it always have to be spiders??
  • Wolf mini. A lone wolf stalking the party or just copy/paste this mini to create a formidable pack of wolves to increase the challenge
  • 3 beautiful adventure maps ready to play!

Each map features the water, forest and outdoor terrain artfully composed and ready-to-play. Just have the party join the game, drop in their minis and let the adventure begin! Perhaps these maps will inspire you to build your own maps that you can share with the party for FREE or share with the community on the Mirrorscape HUB?
